record.excerpt: The inference process was not interrupted, but at a lower speed, 2 FPS, in the experiment.
record.finding: In Stage 2, when UAV#3's communication program was disabled and UAV#3 became unavailable, the eCoEl prototype continued collaborative Faster R-CNN video-stream inference without interruption at approximately 2 FPS.

quantitative.baseline: ~3 FPS with four UAVs (UAV#1 to UAV#4) collaborating in Stage 1
quantitative.workload: Faster R-CNN object detection on a video stream
quantitative.conditions: Stage 2: communication program of UAV#3 disabled (one of four UAVs unavailable)
